newsitem.title: CANADA: Breakwater to sell C$25 mln in warrants.
newsitem.headline: Breakwater to sell C$25 mln in warrants.

text.p: Breakwater Resources Ltd said on Thursday a syndicate of underwriters has agreed to buy for resale 8,333,333 special warrants of Breakwater at C$3.00 per special warrant, for gross proceeds of C$25 million.

The underwriters will have the option to increase the size of the offering by an additional 1.25 million special warrants at any time prior to the closing date, which is expected to be about February 20, 1997.
Breakwater said each special warrant, upon exchange, will entitle the holder to acquire for no additional consideration one common share of Breakwater.
Proceeds of the issue will be used to refinance existing indebtedness and credit lines relating to the construction of the Caribou and Restigouche mines in New Brunswick.
